item.title: Turbulence Forces Flight Bound for Rhodes Back to Athens (VID)
item.description: Severe weather conditions disrupted air travel across Greece, forcing a flight bound for Rhodes to turn back to Athens after encountering intense turbulence. The aircraft departed Athens with a delay and reached the airspace above Rhodes but failed to land due to violent air turbulence caused by adverse weather. item.title: Greece Pushes Establishment of Migrant Return Hubs in Africa
item.description: Greece has moved to the forefront of European Union discussions on establishing migrant “return hubs” in Africa, as Brussels seeks more effective ways to manage irregular migration flows. Return hubs would operate as reception and repatriation centres for migrants whose asylum applications have been rejected.
